base_prompt:
SPRITE for a comedic 2D game, full body, transparent background (real alpha channel), no ground shadow, no glow, no text, ONE character, nothing cropped, centered, portrait about 2:3.
REDRAW the attached character (same character idea, outfit, colors, pose) in the art style described below. Keep it simple and readable at a very small size. Flat colors, at most one soft shade tone, no glossy highlights, no fabric wrinkles, no realistic anatomy. It must look hand-drawn by an illustrator, NOT like a typical AI render.

jobs.name: kid_jp
jobs.prompt: STYLE: Japanese kawaii anime chibi (2.5 heads tall), like a cute mascot character from a Japanese mobile game: clean thin dark-brown outline (not thick), big glossy anime eyes with two white sparkles, tiny nose and mouth, pastel candy colors, one flat soft shadow tone. CHARACTER: the good kid with blue coat, red beanie with white pom-pom, red-white striped scarf, red mittens, small golden halo, arms up, happy open-mouth smile.

jobs.name: thug_jp
jobs.prompt: STYLE: Japanese kawaii anime chibi (2.5 heads tall), like a cute-but-mean rival character in a Japanese mobile game: clean thin dark outline, big expressive anime eyes (red, narrowed, angry brows), small fangs, flat colors with one soft shadow tone. CHARACTER: the bad kid with red bandana and red mohawk, gold chain, dark purple jacket, torn jeans, boots, nail bat on the shoulder, scowling.

jobs.name: goblin_jp
jobs.prompt: STYLE: Japanese kawaii anime chibi (2.5 heads tall), like a mischievous creature from a Japanese mobile game: clean thin dark outline, big yellow eyes with slit pupils and sparkles, tiny fangs, flat colors with one soft shadow tone. CHARACTER: the goblin kid with green skin, huge pointy ears, ragged brown tunic, hugging a stolen red gift box with a naughty grin.

jobs.name: kid_kr
jobs.prompt: STYLE: Korean messenger-sticker / emoticon style (like KakaoTalk or LINE friends): very simple chubby rounded character (2 heads tall), minimal face with small dot eyes and a tiny smile, soft muted pastel palette, thin uniform outline in a slightly darker tone of the fill color, almost no detail. CHARACTER: the good kid with blue coat, red beanie with white pom-pom, red-white scarf, red mittens, small golden halo, arms up.

jobs.name: thug_kr
jobs.prompt: STYLE: Korean messenger-sticker / emoticon style (like KakaoTalk or LINE friends): very simple chubby rounded character (2 heads tall), minimal face with small dot eyes and angry slanted eyebrows, soft muted palette with dark purple and red accents, thin uniform outline, almost no detail. CHARACTER: the bad kid with red bandana and red mohawk, gold chain, dark jacket, jeans, boots, nail bat on the shoulder, grumpy.

jobs.name: goblin_kr
jobs.prompt: STYLE: Korean messenger-sticker / emoticon style (like KakaoTalk or LINE friends): very simple chubby rounded character (2 heads tall), minimal face with small dot eyes and a sneaky wide smile, soft muted green palette, thin uniform outline, almost no detail. CHARACTER: the goblin kid with huge pointy ears, ragged brown tunic, hugging a stolen red gift box.
